positions.as_written: Measure alignment, since varus loads both.
Treat this as the combination where the environment, the structures and the alignment all have to be addressed, and where a single sitting may not be possible.
Plan tunnels to avoid convergence, considering an inlay for the cruciate.
Measure both components before and after, by their own methods.
Counsel that outcomes in this combination are worse than in isolated injury.
